title: Improved Diagnostics of Celiac Disease in Children
brief_summary: The main purpose of this study is to improve the diagnostics of celiac disease and reduce the need for invasive endoscopic studies in children. Further, the investigators aim to investigate the natural history and risk of complications in children with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity and to create a large scientific database.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Suspicion of celiac disease or gluten sensitivity
* Age below 18 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* Study refusal
* Age 18 years or more
study_population: Hospital clinic; secondary and tertiary centers
